title: A City of Many Cultures
text:
Our city has people from many countries. Every family brings its own food, music and holidays. In my school, students speak more than ten languages.

Last month, my class had a festival. Each student brought a traditional dish from home. We tasted food from Japan, Brazil and Nigeria. Everyone learned something new.

questions.text: How many languages do students speak in the school?
What did each student bring to the festival?
What can we infer about the class?
options: The students learned about each other's cultures
The students did not like the food
The class had no new students
The festival was held in another city

questions.text: Why did the writer say that everyone learned something new?
options: Because the festival showed different cultures
Because the teacher gave a test
Because the students went to the airport

vocabulary.definition: a special event where people celebrate together
belonging to the customs of a group for a long time
systems of words that people use to communicate

paragraph_translations: Наше місто має людей з багатьох країн. Кожна родина приносить свою їжу, музику та свята. У моїй школі учні говорять більш ніж десятьма мовами.
Минулого місяця в моєму класі відбулося свято. Кожен учень приніс традиційну страву з дому. Ми скуштували їжу з Японії, Бразилії та Нігерії. Кожен дізнався щось нове.
